_comment: Held-out eval difficulty band, as [min, max] defect magnitude. Read by run.mjs, seed-sweep.mjs, verify-independent.mjs and difficulty.mjs so they cannot drift apart.
_procedure: Re-derive with `node bench/difficulty.mjs` whenever the band saturates. Note the constraint discovered in docs/STALL-LOG.md: the `typography` class has an IRREDUCIBLE detection cliff at mag ~0.0148 caused by glyph hinting in the rasterizer (changedRows jumps 12 -> 25 in one 0.00025 step, because the spec's font size is continuous but the rendered glyph grid is not). Every band that yields an intermediate typography score straddles that cliff, so its score reflects band placement rather than judge quality. The band is therefore kept ABOVE the cliff, where the score is stable and usable as a regression gate.
_history: [0.06, 0.11] - first band after de-quantization; solved to 30/30 perfect seeds, retired.
[0.03, 0.06] - second; also solved to saturation, retired.
[0.01, 0.02]  - third; RETIRED because it straddled the typography cliff at 0.0148, making its 0.9167 headline a step-function artefact rather than a gradient (critic-4 finding, confirmed).

[0.015, 0.0195] - current. Sits entirely above the cliff, so every class is stable and correct; the score is a regression gate, not a capability gradient. See the known-limitations section of bench/README.md.
